# Center for the Study of Child Care Employment

> CSCCE is a national leader in early care and education workforce research, policy analysis, and advocacy for educator compensation, professional development, and equity.

Based at UC Berkeley since 1999, CSCCE conducts rigorous research on the early childhood education workforce and translates findings into actionable resources for educators, policymakers, and advocates. The center focuses on critical issues including educator compensation, workforce equity, leadership development, and work environment quality.

## Key Topics

- Early childhood education (ECE)
- Educator compensation and wages
- Workforce equity and stratification
- Teacher professional development
- Policy research and advocacy
- Work environments and SEQUAL
- Racial wage gaps
- Early childhood leadership
- Workforce data systems
- Child care employment
- Teacher preparation
- State policy
- Teacher activism
- California workforce
- UC Berkeley research

## About CSCCE

- [Center for the Study of Child Care Employment](https://cscce.berkeley.edu): National leader in early care and education workforce research and policy
- [About Us](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/about-us): CSCCE's mission, purpose, and approach to ECE workforce research
- [Our History](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/about-us/our-history): CSCCE's founding and evolution since 1999 in child care workforce
- [Our Staff](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/about-us/our-staff): Staff directory and team member information

## Research Areas

- [Research Areas](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/research-areas): Overview of CSCCE's key research focus areas and topics
- [Compensation](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/research-areas/compensation): Research on educator compensation, wages, and retention
- [Stratification & Equity](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/research-areas/stratification-equity): Research examining racial wage gaps and equity in ECE workforce
- [Teacher Work Environments](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/research-areas/teacher-work-environments): Research on supportive work environments and SEQUAL survey
- [Leadership](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/research-areas/leadership): Research on early childhood leadership development and diversity
- [Teacher Development & Preparation](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/research-areas/teacher-development-preparation): Research on ECE teacher preparation and professional development
- [Workforce Data](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/research-areas/workforce-data): Workforce data systems and Early Education Workforce Index

## Projects & Publications

- [Projects](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/projects): Overview of CSCCE's major research projects and initiatives
- [Blog](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/blog): Blog posts on ECE policy, compensation, and workforce topics

## Resources by Audience

- [For Educators](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/publications/early-educators): Advocacy toolkits and resources for early educators
- [For Advocates & Policymakers](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/publications/advocates-policymakers): Policy resources and reform strategies for advocates and legislators
- [For Journalists](https://cscce.berkeley.edu/publications/journalists): Media resources and data on ECE workforce for journalists
